module "P_Inline.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_Inline"
  pipeline order=0 injection=BeforePostProcess views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  hlsl line=6 lines=7
  buffer "Mask" R8 resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  buffer "Soft" R8 resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  pass "Fill" compute injection=BeforePostProcess
    hlsl Shared entry=FillCS
    threads=(8, 8, 1) (from the shader) dispatch=Mask * 1
    write Result = Mask
  pass "Again" compute injection=BeforePostProcess
    hlsl Body line=26 lines=3 entry=-
    threads=(8, 8, 1) (from the shader) dispatch=Soft * 1
    read Source = Mask
    write Result = Soft
